package.description: DSH Desktop 是由社区维护的 DeepSeek Harness 桌面客户端，并非 DeepSeek 官方产品。

en-US.description: A community-maintained desktop client for DeepSeek Harness; it is not an official DeepSeek product.
en-US.longDescription: DSH Desktop is a community-maintained desktop client for DeepSeek Harness. It is an Electron desktop shell and is not an official DeepSeek product.
en-US.releaseNotes:
This Next release upgrades upstream to the release candidate DeepSeek Harness v0.2.2-rc.1, bringing on-demand macOS Computer Use (dsh-cua-bundle), OAR Subagents, LiveShare, and one-click third-party plugin updates to Next, adding embedded account top-up and usage views, native Save As, and image file drag-out, and fixing Windows sandbox command failures and idle Host exits.
DSH NEXT is a community-maintained open-source project, not an official DeepSeek product.
Upstream version: DeepSeek Harness v0.2.2-rc.1.
Upstream kernel breaking changes (dsh v0.2.2-rc.1)
DeepSeek Harness v0.2.2-rc.1 includes kernel API and runtime breaking changes that may affect third-party plugins and self-deployed environments:
- Third-party and custom plugin compatibility: Upstream upgrades to Cordis 4.1.0 and refactors conditional per-step tool activation, native vs. PTC tool execution, fixed per-step model routing, and asynchronous session projections; the standalone Git worktree plugin is now merged into Change requests and worktrees. Third-party plugins not yet updated for 0.2.2 may prevent startup and can be updated or disabled via Safe Mode or Plugins → Installed in the recovery assistant; on-demand official bundles from an older release are automatically cleaned up before startup and can be re-enabled in Plugins.
- Self-deployed PTC and remote SSH upgrade requirements: The PTC control channel now uses birpc, the SSH protocol is bumped to v3, and cancelled execution status codes now return ABORTED; self-deployed bootstraps and remote SSH helpers must be upgraded together with 0.2.2-rc.1.
- Runtime and default policy changes: The minimum Node.js version for running DSH externally is raised to 24.9 (packaged desktop builds already bundle Node 24.21); undeclared custom-model capacities default to 1M context / 128K output; read-before-write and external-change checks are disabled by default; web_fetch allows proxy and private-network addresses by default.
New and improved
- New macOS Computer Use (dsh-cua-bundle) and dual-version switching: Added on-demand installation of dsh-cua-bundle on macOS with a toggle on the Computer Use (Next) detail page (supported on macOS 14+ for PTC mode); enabling it automatically takes over PTC sessions and hides Computer Use (Next)’s command and tools without a restart.
- OAR Subagents, LiveShare, and plugin management: Added OAR Subagents (delegate independent tasks to local Claude Code or Codex CLIs with configurable default permissions), LiveShare (Experimental), Ralph, and Session Search to the Plugins page; added version checks and one-click updates for third-party market plugins under Plugins → Installed.
- Upstream 0.2.2-rc.1 highlights and native desktop integration: Quote chat text into the composer, copy full conversations as Markdown, keep all assistant text replies visible when steps are collapsed, upload images immediately in the composer, use unified context and keyboard menus, browse a persistent directory tree in file previews, and manage scheduled tasks at the Host level; Desktop adds embedded account top-up and usage views, native context-menu "Save as" and cross-origin image copy, and native file drag-out for conversation and preview images.
- Linux update checks, CLI, and "Open In": Linux builds now check for updates and open the download page, and support running the bundled CLI directly via <app> dsh <args>; "Open In" now detects Windows Terminal and apps under non-ASCII paths on Windows, plus Ptyxis and GNOME Console on Linux.
Fixes
- Windows sandbox and encoding compatibility: Fixed confined commands exiting without output, failing after temp directory cleanup, or spawning a second GUI window from the tray terminal’s dsh CLI; prevented selecting the installation directory as a workspace or data directory; fixed garbled Chinese output from Python in pwsh and UTF-8 BOMs in config files triggering recovery.
- Host stability and recovery diagnostics: Fixed late background bridge call timeouts while idle terminating the Plugin Host; surfaced the Host's first fatal error line at the top of recovery details; fixed accumulated browser cookies causing HTTP 431 errors after repeated restarts.
- UI interaction and Linux packaging: Restored clipboard access in app-origin plugin views such as Office, made the top strip of the Automation page draggable on macOS, linked "Release notes" to the installed version by default, and fixed LiveShare reader pages failing to load when certain owner plugins are enabled; added multi-size desktop icons and missing Debian audio/graphics dependencies on Linux.
Usage notes
- Quit the previous version and back up ~/.dsh (or use Back up in Settings → Desktop settings) before installing. Verify your usual plugins and workflows afterward.
- Before managing plugins for the desktop Profile from the bundled terminal, launch Desktop to initialize that Profile.
- When upgrading from 2.0.17-next or earlier, download and install manually; in-app updates in those versions may not complete the download.
- The Office skills install the bundled runtime under ~/.dsh/dsh-runtimes/dsh-next-primary-runtime on first use, requiring additional disk space.
- Defaults to the shared ~/.dsh home. Profiles do not isolate sessions, accounts, or credentials within that home.
- Change the data directory in Settings → Desktop settings or the recovery assistant, or set DSH_DESKTOP_NEXT_HOME to an absolute path to isolate DSH data (an in-app choice takes precedence over the environment variable); this does not isolate AA’s default shared sign-in and device-binding state.
Full changelog · Project website
DSH NEXT replaces the former Stable edition channel.

zh-CN.description: DSH Desktop 是由社区维护的 DeepSeek Harness 桌面客户端，并非 DeepSeek 官方产品。
zh-CN.longDescription: DSH Desktop 把 DeepSeek Harness 的本地 Web UI、Host 服务和插件系统装进原生桌面应用。官方 Harness 以固定版本原样运行；Desktop 负责窗口、托盘、终端、更新和工作配置，并通过官方插件机制与 Harness 组合。
zh-CN.name: DSH Desktop
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
本次 Next 更新将上游升级至候选版 DeepSeek Harness v0.2.2-rc.1，同步引入新版 macOS Computer Use（dsh-cua-bundle）、OAR Subagents、LiveShare 与第三方插件一键更新，补齐账户内嵌充值与用量页、右键另存为与图片文件拖出，并修复 Windows 沙箱命令失败与空闲时 Host 退出等问题。
DSH NEXT 是社区维护的开源项目，并非 DeepSeek 官方产品。
上游版本： DeepSeek Harness v0.2.2-rc.1。
上游内核破坏性更新（dsh v0.2.2-rc.1）
本次升级至 DeepSeek Harness v0.2.2-rc.1 包含内核接口与运行时破坏性变更，可能影响第三方插件与自部署环境：
- 第三方与自定义插件兼容性：上游升级至 Cordis 4.1.0，重构了工具按步骤激活、原生与 PTC 工具执行拆分、模型路由固定及异步会话投影接口；原独立“Git 工作树”插件已并入“变更请求与工作树”。尚未适配 0.2.2 的第三方插件可能导致启动失败，可在恢复助手中通过安全模式或“插件 → 已安装”更新／禁用；旧版本按需安装的官方组件会在启动前自动清理，在“插件”页重新开启即可安装当前版本。
- 自部署 PTC 与远程 SSH 升级要求：PTC 控制通道改用 birpc，SSH 协议升至 v3，取消执行状态码改为 ABORTED；自部署 bootstrap 或远程 SSH helper 需与 0.2.2-rc.1 同步升级。
- 运行环境与默认策略变更：外部运行 DSH 的最低 Node.js 版本提升至 24.9（桌面安装包已内置 Node 24.21）；未声明容量的自定义模型默认上下文／输出调整为 1M / 128K；文件修改前的先读与外部修改检查默认关闭；web_fetch 默认允许访问代理与内网地址。
新增与改进
- 新版 macOS Computer Use（dsh-cua-bundle）与双版本切换：macOS 下支持按需下载安装 dsh-cua-bundle，并在 Computer Use (Next) 详情页提供切换开关（macOS 14+ 支持，用于 PTC 模式）；启用后在 PTC 会话中自动接管并隐藏 Computer Use (Next) 的命令与工具，切换无需重启。
- OAR Subagents、LiveShare 与插件管理：插件页上架 OAR Subagents（可将独立任务委派给本机 Claude Code 或 Codex 并配置默认权限）、LiveShare（实验）、Ralph 与 Session Search；“插件 → 已安装”支持检查第三方市场插件新版本并一键更新。
- 上游 0.2.2-rc.1 特性与原生桌面集成：支持选中聊天文本引用、复制完整会话为 Markdown、收起步骤保留全部助手文字回复、图片进入输入框即上传、全局统一右键与键盘菜单、文件预览常驻目录树及宿主级“自动化任务”管理；桌面端补齐账户充值与用量的应用内嵌视图、右键原生“另存为”与跨域图片复制，以及会话与预览图片直接作为文件拖出。
- Linux 更新检查、CLI 与“打开方式”: Linux 版支持检查更新并打开下载页，支持通过 <app> dsh <参数> 直接运行内置 CLI；Windows“打开方式”支持识别 Windows Terminal 及中文路径下的应用，Linux 新增识别 Ptyxis 与 GNOME Console。
修复
- Windows 沙箱与编码兼容：修复 Windows 受限沙箱下命令无输出退出、临时目录被系统清理后报错，以及托盘终端运行 dsh 命令误拉起第二个桌面窗口的问题；禁止将应用安装目录选为工作区或数据目录；修复 pwsh 调用 Python 中文乱码及配置文件含 UTF-8 BOM 导致进入恢复助手的问题。
- Host 稳定性与恢复诊断：修复空闲或重连时后台桥接调用超时导致 Plugin Host 退出的问题；恢复助手错误详情顶部直接展示 Host 首条致命错误摘要；修复多次重启后浏览器或局域网访问因 Cookie 累积报 HTTP 431 的问题。
- 界面交互与 Linux 打包：修复 Office 等应用内插件视图无法复制粘贴、自动化页面顶部无法拖动窗口、“更新公告”按钮默认未指向当前版本，以及 LiveShare 读者端在部分插件开启时无法加载页面的问题；补齐 Linux 安装包桌面图标与 Debian 音频／图形依赖。
使用提示
- 请先退出旧版应用并备份 ~/.dsh（或在“设置 → 桌面设置”中使用“备份”），安装后验证常用插件和工作流程。
- 如需通过应用内终端管理 desktop Profile 的插件，请先启动 Desktop 完成该 Profile 的初始化。
- 从 2.0.17-next 或更早版本升级时，建议手动下载安装；旧版应用内更新可能无法完成下载。
- Office 文档技能首次使用时将随包运行时安装到 ~/.dsh/dsh-runtimes/dsh-next-primary-runtime，需要额外磁盘空间。
- 默认与旧稳定版共用 ~/.dsh；Profile 不隔离同一目录中的会话、账号和凭据。
- 可在“设置 → 桌面设置”或恢复助手中切换数据目录，也可通过绝对路径 DSH_DESKTOP_NEXT_HOME 隔离 DSH 数据（应用内选择优先于环境变量），但不会因此隔离 AA 的默认共享登录与设备绑定状态。
完整变更记录 · 项目网站
DSH NEXT 已取代原稳定版通道。
